reuse.why: Builds on the existing guardBankAccountLink and turns the assert into a lookup, but copies unlinkAccount's field-clearing update instead of extracting and sharing it.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount that defines the unlinked state is pasted from unlinkAccount, so the two unlink paths can drift.

placement.why: The replace decision sits in the shared link guard that already enforces the closed-account and duplicate-link rules, so every provider gets it; doing a data write inside a guard wrapper is slightly surprising.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard logic and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Small and covers all providers, but the copied unlink state means a future change to what 'unlinked' means must be made in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts guardBankAccountLink re-implements the unlink state update inline instead of reusing the logic in unlinkAccount (e.g. via an extracted local-unlink helper).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied db.updateAccount block is an open, verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's, not reshaped.
